operating_hours: 08:00 - 18:00 (Reservations for 08:00-08:30 must be made by the previous day)
operating_days: Monday to Sunday (Closed: Year-end/New Year holidays Dec 29 – Jan 3)

passes.note: One-day passes (500 yen for adults / 250 yen for students/disabled) and multi-ride coupons are available.

reservation_methods.note: Prior user registration is mandatory and takes 10–14 days to process.
Reservations accepted from 1 week prior. Maximum of 6 active bookings per person.

reservation_window: From 1 week in advance until 30 minutes before boarding (or same-day)
important_notes: User registration is required before first use (submit by mail or at City Hall).
Registration takes approximately 2 weeks to complete.
Travel is restricted to within specific zones; crossing between different service zones is generally not permitted in a single ride.
Wait times may occur as this is a ride-sharing service.
